sources.title: Uzbek Soviet Socialist Republic
sources.note: 27 October 1924; 15 October 1929 Tajik ASSR and Khujand split off; Karakalpakstan 5 December 1936; renamed Uzbek SSR December 1936; Samarkand to Tashkent 1930; sovereignty 20 June 1990; 31 August 1991; area 447,400 km2 (no year); no Turkmen/Kyrgyz border changes.

sources.title: Tajik Soviet Socialist Republic
sources.note: Tajik ASSR created 14 October 1924 as a part of the Uzbek SSR; union republic 5 December 1929.

sources.title: Karakalpak Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic
sources.note: ASSR 20 March 1932; moved from the RSFSR to the Uzbek SSR 5 December 1936.

notes: No Cliopatria row; the land lies inside Union of Soviet Socialist Republics shapes (1924-1991); Cliopatria's Republic of Uzbekistan begins in 1992. The republic is an internal unit of the Soviet Union. The three predecessor states (turkestan-assr, bukharan-people-s-soviet-republic, khorezm-people-s-soviet-republic) have dossiers that carve their own lands; the gains here reuse their admin1 lines. Dates disagree: 15 October 1929 (Uzbek page) and December 1929 (Tajik page) for the Tajik SSR; Karakalpakstan joined from the RSFSR (Karakalpak page, the Kazakh and RSFSR dossiers) or the Kazakh SSR (Uzbek page); independence recognised 25 or 26 December 1991. The Uzbek page says the Turkestan ASSR, Bukharan and Khorezm republics were abolished without dates; the dossiers give October 1924. Not on the page: Tashkent-region and Bostandyk transfers with the Kazakh SSR (undated), the Gorno-Badakhshan lines. The Tajik ASSR is a vassal of this republic from 1924 to 1929 (the Tajik dossier is in this batch).
